$comment: Schema 1 of the catalogue. Every value in SI units, given in each number's "unit"; an empty CSV field is a value the source does not give.
title: gearbox
description: A gearbox: one size, motor frame and ratio. Torques at the output, stiffness and backlash referred to the output, inertia to the input.

backlash_reduced_rad.description: Backlash of the maker's reduced-backlash option, a maximum as backlash_rad is.

motor_frame.description: The motor frame code the gearbox fits, as text: for Siemens' geared motors the frame in the motor's article number (e.g. "04"); for makers that fit any motor through an adapter, the input bore code as printed (e.g. "19" for a 19 mm clamping hub, see clamping_hub_diameter_m).

clamping_hub_diameter_m.description: Bore of the input's clamping hub (or wave generator): the largest motor shaft it takes; a smaller one takes a bushing. For makers that fit any motor through an adapter plate; empty for the Siemens geared motors, which fit by motor_frame.

rated_input_speed_rad_s.description: Nominal (thermally permissible mean) input speed: WITTENSTEIN n1N, Neugart n1N, Harmonic Drive's limit for the average input speed.

no_load_torque_nm.description: Torque at the input to turn the gearbox without load, at no_load_torque_speed_rad_s and the maker's reference temperature (in the table's notes).

no_load_torque_speed_rad_s.description: Input speed at which no_load_torque_nm holds.

max_radial_force_n.description: Highest radial force on the output shaft, at the maker's reference point (in the notes).

stiffness_t1_nm.description: Strain-wave gears: torque up to which stiffness_k1_nm_rad holds.

stiffness_t2_nm.description: Strain-wave gears: torque up to which stiffness_k2_nm_rad holds (above it stiffness_k3_nm_rad).

hysteresis_rad.description: Hysteresis loss of the torsion curve, referred to the output.

lost_motion_rad.description: Lost motion at the maker's test torque, referred to the output.

mass.description: The mass of a gearbox; motor_frames lists the motor frames, separated by blanks, that share it.
